What is the difference between nickel-plated strip and pure nickel strip?

Nickel-plated strip is steel coated with a layer of nickel, offering good conductivity and corrosion resistance at a lower cost. Pure nickel strip is solid nickel, offering lower resistance, better conductivity and superior corrosion resistance — ideal for high-performance battery packs and EV applications.
